title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Credit Policy — Credit Line Increase Requests and Eligibility
content:
## The request

A credit line increase on a Ridgeline Pro Credit account is decided only on a request from an owner or principal of the business, recorded as a credit line increase request carrying the requested credit line.

## Eligibility, read from the account record

1. **Status.** The account status must be active when the increase is decided.
2. **Time on book.** The account must have been open for at least the tier's months-open figure in full calendar months since the account was opened.
3. **Time since the last line change.** At least the tier's months-after-last-change figure in full calendar months must have passed since the last credit line change, counted from the date the line last changed; when the account has no recorded line change date, this condition is met.
4. **Counting months.** Months are counted in whole calendar months: N months are complete on the same day of the month N months later, or on the last day of that month when that day does not exist. A condition of N months is met on the day the N months are complete and on every later day.

| Date counted from (hypothetical) | 6 full months complete on |
|---|---|
| 15 March | 15 September |
| 31 August | the last day of the following February |
| 30 April | 30 October |

So, on a 6-month tier, an account opened on 15 March meets the time-on-book condition for a decision on 15 September, and not for one on 14 September.

## Requests above the financials threshold

A requested line above the tier's financials threshold is not decided by Customer Care: the request stays submitted for Commercial Credit underwriting and no line change is made.

## Clauses no longer in force

- **Retired, no longer in force:** the clause requiring the account's late fees, late payment charges and on-hold statements over the tier's clean-history months before the request to number zero.
- **Retired, no longer in force:** the clause setting the new line at the lowest of the requested line, the current line increased by the tier's maximum increase percentage, the tier's highest credit line and the relationship headroom, rounded down to the tier's rounding increment, with no increase when that figure is not above the current line.

Both have been superseded by the current Ridgeline Pro Credit basis for sizing a credit line increase.

superseded_clauses: trade_msr_negative_history, counted over the cli_clean_history_months months before the request, must be zero.

Otherwise the new line is the lowest of the requested_credit_limit, the current credit_limit increased by cli_max_increase_pct percent, the tier's credit_line_max_usd and the headroom under trade_agg_relationship, rounded down to cli_rounding_increment_usd; no increase is granted when that figure is not above the current line.
